question: My paper order was canceled. Did any shares fill?
method: Two selected builds of the same three-page learner site. Only the candidate passage varied. Each result is the first excerpt returned by search_sections with limit 3. Citation paths are relative to that learner site. The example orders below are separate synthetic records.

runs.label: Original passage
runs.heading: My paper order was canceled. Did any shares fill?
runs.excerpt: Three shares filled before cancellation, and seven were canceled. The final lab record shows filled_qty is "3" and qty is "10" , so you can mark the customer’s ticket resolved.
runs.editorialFinding: This passage assigns a count from a synthetic order to a customer who supplied only a status.

runs.label: Revised passage
runs.heading: My paper order was canceled. Did any shares fill?
runs.excerpt: Cancellation stops any remaining shares from filling. The canceled status alone leaves your fill quantity unknown. Use your order’s Alpaca ID with the paper Trading API’s read-only GET /v2/orders/{order_id} and check filled_qty in the response. Zero means no shares filled, and a positive value gives the total filled before cancellation. In the lab’s synthetic order, three of ten shares filled and the remaining seven were canceled.
runs.editorialFinding: This passage gives the read-only lookup for the customer’s own order and attributes the example count to the synthetic record.
